title: Follow Every Thread with the Story Timeline
use_cases: Use when tracking individual character arcs throughout a manuscript
Implement when mapping specific plot beats to exact chapter locations
Configure when highlighting major reveals or cliffhangers to maintain pacing
Use when reviewing the chronological progression of events across multiple chapters
content:
See how each character's arc unfolds chapter by chapter. The Story Timeline tracks every event, progression, and major reveal across your entire manuscript — so you always know where every thread left off.

![Story Timeline — chapter-by-chapter event tracking with progressions, reveals, and plot beats](https://proseengine.app/assets/landing-story-timeline.png?v=1)

📍

Scene-by-Scene Events

Every plot beat pinned to its exact chapter and location

💡

Reveals & Turning Points

Major reveals and cliffhangers highlighted so nothing slips through

🔄

Character Progressions

Track how characters evolve from first appearance to final scene
